Q: Finding IP Address of Oracle Database Server A:

Execute this once you login with sqlplus or sqldeveloper

SELECT sys_context('userenv','server_host') FROM DUAL;

Q: What is the returned value of a subquery based on the count of result rows? A:

In scalar context the subquery will return:

  • NULL if 0 rows returned
  • The value returned if 1 row returned
  • An error if 2 or more rows returned.
